notes: Caps, controls, and acceptance gates were registered before the B1/B2 batch was run.
Both variants receive task.question plus decision_context and use the same collector, corpus, top-k, and three-call allowance.
Automatic gate: both variants complete 10/10 tasks, B2 evidence-obligation recall is at least B1 plus 0.10, and structural citation integrity is 1.0.
Planned human gate: B2 blind obligation coverage is at least B1 plus 0.10, citation support is no worse than B1 minus 0.05, and irrelevant-claim rate is no worse than B1 plus 0.05.
AI-assisted review is calibration-only and cannot satisfy the planned human gate.
